articles.title: Citi, Goldman, other global banks and asset managers team up on stablecoin venture
articles.snippet: The group will focus first on a U.S. dollar stablecoin for payments and digital asset settlement, with a euro token a priority for expansion.

articles.title: Ethena pushes stablecoins into everyday banking with high-yield savings, cards and payments
articles.snippet: Ethena Pay offers a 6% dollar savings rate and 5% card cashback, using Avalanche for settlement.

articles.title: Wyoming adds Chainlink reserve verification to state-issued stable token
articles.snippet: Wyoming is using Chainlink to bring near-real-time reserve verification onchain for FRNT as the oracle provider expands its footprint across tokenized financial markets.

articles.title: BofA, Citi, Goldman Sachs among 21 institutions planning stablecoin launch
articles.snippet: The planned venture will initially focus on a US dollar stablecoin before expanding to other G7 currencies, with a euro-denominated offering next.

articles.title: Kast launches stablecoin-powered business platform after $80M raise
articles.snippet: Kast aims to onboard between 1,000 and 5,000 active businesses to its new platform by the end of 2026.
